dogecoin.text: Proof of stake can offer the crypto sector a dramatically greener future. It will be really good if Dogecoin has a plan for switching over from PoW to a more efficient proof-of-stake system.

Ross Nicoll said that the team of four part-time Dogecoin developers are optimistic that with Musk in the picture, they could further reduce the cryptocurrency’s energy consumption — which, by one estimation on Thursday, is already just 7% of Bitcoin’s.
Proof of stake can offer the crypto sector a dramatically greener future. It will be really good if Dogecoin has a plan for switching over from PoW to a more efficient proof-of-stake system.
